name: A mugging
prompt: On the walk home a man steps out of a doorway and says to give him your money.

outcome.told: He takes the cash and is gone round the corner.
outcome.line: {you} was robbed on the walk home.
{you} ran from a mugger and got away.

failure.told: He catches your jacket. You fall hard, and he takes the cash.
failure.line: {you} was knocked down and robbed on the walk home.
